description: Set one project.godot setting without launching Godot. Pass value (JSON, converted to a Godot literal) or literal (raw Godot text, e.g. "Vector2i(1280, 720)"), not both. Rewrites the last assignment in place or adds key/section; other lines stay byte for byte. Refuses autoload/* (use the autoload tools). Returns: { section, key, value read back, created, sectionCreated, previous? }.

key.description: Setting key within the section, e.g. "window/size/viewport_width". Same character set as section.

literal.description: Raw Godot literal written as is, on one line, with no trailing comment: "str", 1.5, true, null, [1, 2], {"a": 1} or a constructor such as Vector2i(1, 2) or PackedStringArray("a"). Checked by reading it back as one complete value. Resource(...), Object(...), ExtResource(...) and SubResource(...) are refused: Godot may then fail to load project.godot.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

section.description: INI section, e.g. "display" or "application". Letters, digits and _ . - /, no spaces.

value.description: JSON value converted to a Godot literal: a string is quoted, an integer-valued number is an int (write 2 as literal "2.0" for a float), a boolean is true/false, an array becomes [a, b], an object a dictionary. null is not accepted; use literal "null".

name: set_project_setting

created.description: True when the key was added, false when an existing assignment was rewritten.

previous.description: The value that was replaced; absent when created.

sectionCreated.description: True when the section did not exist and was appended.

value.description: The setting as get_project_settings reads it back after the write: a string unescaped, a number or boolean typed, anything else its raw text.

warnings.description: Present only when there is something to say, e.g. project.godot has lines not in the form Godot writes.
